summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 39 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 11 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie made a point enterprise AI teams should internalize: code is uniquely amenable to agents because it is testable—you can manually run the app or run automated tests to verify correctness. Most other work lacks this; you only get the test when a trade executes, a contract is negotiated, or a pitch is delivered. His conclusion: enterprises that gain most from AI are the ones that can "eval" their knowledge work—building evals per workflow so they know whether a model/prompt/system change broke or…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这周提了一个很值得企业 AI 团队记住的判断：代码之所以特别适合 agent，是因为它天然「可测试」——写完能立刻手动跑或跑自动化测试来验证对错。而其他大部分工作没这个便利，一笔交易、一份合同、一次销售演示，往往要等到成品进入真实世界才知道成没成。他由此推出一个结论：企业要从 AI 里拿到最大收益，前提是能把自己的知识型工作「eval 化」——为每个工作流建立评估基准，才能知道换了模型、prompt 或系统之后是变好还是变坏。他判断谁能把知识工作评估做到最好，谁就能从 AI 里获益最多，这将是 agent 规模化落地的关键。另一条他转了一份 AI 标准化机构的提案，强调这应区别于监管机构、能让标准更快迭代，别让 AI 进展被政府的传统节奏拖慢。

featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch announced Vercel is opening up its dataset of AI token flows on the AI Gateway, calling out fascinating insights into how AI is actually used, and built a visualization on top of it—a rare piece of first-party usage data for anyone doing enterprise AI procurement or cost analysis. In the same thread he plugged AgentMail's Vercel integration: `vercel install agentmail` gives an agent email capability with no signup, automatic setup, and unified billing—another concrete example of the "age…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 宣布开放 Vercel AI Gateway 上的 AI token 流向数据集，声称里面有不少「关于 AI 使用真实分布」的有趣洞察，并已用这份数据做了可视化。对做企业 AI 采购和成本分析的人来说，这是一份难得的一手用量数据。同一条时间线他还推了 AgentMail 的 Vercel 集成：一句 `vercel install agentmail` 就能让 agent 自动获得邮件能力，无需注册、自动配置、统一计费——这是「agent 即用即装工具」这条产品线的又一个具体样本。

featured.title: Anthropic 平台负责人 Katelyn Lesse & Angela Jiang：建生态，而非围墙花园
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic's platform team frames building agents as a three-layer cake—knowledge → execution → coordination—and is betting its future on the top "strategies / meta-harness" layer, where you give each token a job (execute, reflect and write learnings to memory, advise with a big model, grade-and-retry). That's where the alpha is. They also argue the right way to "save tokens" is not to stop using AI but to build routers and strategies that cut cost without killing innovation. Anthropic's platform, led by Katelyn Lesse and Angela Jiang, is both the external developer API and the internal infrastructure powering all of Anthropic's own products—called by the hosts one of the most important developer platforms in the world. items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Cursor design lead Ryo Lu wrote a moving essay on the specific pain of when your hobby becomes your job—and machines start getting good at your craft. Turning your love into work is a dream, but the cost is that the thing that once belonged only to you no longer does: curiosity becomes roadmap, taste becomes decision-making, play becomes output. Now there's another layer: machines are good not just at the boring parts but at writing, coding, designing, reasoning—the things we used as proof we had something special…
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人 Ryo Lu 写了一篇很动人的长文，谈「当兴趣变成职业、而机器又开始擅长你的手艺」时那种特定的痛。他说把爱好做成工作是梦想，但代价是那个曾经只属于你的东西不再只属于你——好奇心变成路线图，品味变成决策，玩变成产出。而现在又多了一层：机器不只擅长无聊的部分，也开始逼近写作、编码、设计、推理这些曾被当作「你有独特之处」的证明。他的答案不是更努力或更少在乎，而是回到「爱开始的地方」——那个没有观众、没有路线图、没有截止日期的私人角落。因为 AI 能加速产出、甚至抬高手艺的下限，但它无法替你「想要」，无法决定什么值得爱。对身处 AI 浪潮的每个 builder，这是一份关于意义感的提醒。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Anthropic's Claude Code team shared a fun and instructive Claude Code use case: hooked on Pokémon Champions, he had Claude Code call Smogon's npm library, pull live usage stats, and auto-write matchup reports—to understand matchups, compute breakpoints, and theorycraft teams. It's a lightweight but complete example of wiring an agent into a vertical with an API/data source and letting it do analysis and reporting end to end. He said he'll open-source it if there's interest.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 分享了一个很好玩又很实用的 Claude Code 用例：他最近沉迷 Pokémon Champions，就用 Claude Code 调用 Smogon 的 npm 库，拉取实时使用率统计，然后自动写出对战分析报告——用来理解对局、算 breakpoint、甚至理论组队。这是「把 agent 接到一个有 API/数据源的垂直领域，让它自动做分析和报告」的一个轻量但完整的样本，说他如果反响好会开源。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: Sam Altman gave a rare public capacity warning: GPT-5.6 Sol growth is "insane," the inference team has done heroic work to support demand, and OpenAI will "move mountains" to keep scaling—but there may be some hiccups soon. For anyone running production on OpenAI's API, that's a stability-risk signal worth noting. He added a telling line: it's also a reason to favor open-source harnesses—implying that when a hosted service wobbles, a self-controllable open-source harness is a hedge.
items.insightZh: Sam Altman 罕见地对外预警了容量压力：他说 GPT-5.6 Sol 的增长「疯了」，推理团队为支撑需求做了英雄级的工作，OpenAI 会「移山」继续扩容，但近期可能会有一些「小故障」（hiccups）。对依赖 OpenAI API 做生产的人来说，这是一个值得留意的稳定性风险信号。他还补了一句耐人寻味的话：这也是「偏好开源 harness」的一个理由——暗示当托管服务不稳时，可自控的开源 harness 是一种对冲。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI（Codex & ChatGPT）
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux from OpenAI's Codex/ChatGPT team revealed real product-side status: ChatGPT Work and Codex usage may soon hit 9M, and the team is debating whether to reset usage caps again or give it space. He ran a growth incentive—$100 in Codex credits to the first 10k users who tweet why they love GPT-5.6 Sol or why they switched—and openly solicited ChatGPT Work product feedback on X. First-party growth and ops signals for anyone tracking the Codex/ChatGPT Work adoption curve.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT 团队的 Thibault Sottiaux 这几条透露了产品侧的真实状态：ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 的用量可能很快逼近 900 万，团队在纠结是否要再次「重置」用量额度还是留些空间。他还搞了个增长激励——前 1 万个发推说说自己为什么喜欢 GPT-5.6 Sol 或为什么切换过来的用户，送 100 美元 Codex credits。同时他直接在 X 上收集 ChatGPT Work 的产品反馈。对关注 Codex/ChatGPT Work 采用曲线的人，这是一手的增长与运营信号。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang teased a new video on how he uses ChatGPT Work (jokingly "also known as Codex") to do almost everything on his computer. He'll cover his complete setup in 7 steps—from choosing the right GPT-5.6 model to managing email, calendar, and recurring tasks. Worth following for anyone wanting to use ChatGPT Work/Codex as a personal OS-level assistant.
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 预告了一支新视频：分享他如何用 ChatGPT Work（他调侃「也就是 Codex」）在电脑上「几乎做所有事」。他会用 7 步讲完整套配置——从怎么选对 GPT-5.6 模型，到用它管理邮件、日历和周期性任务。对想把 ChatGPT Work/Codex 当作个人操作系统级助手来用的人，这套实操教程值得追。

items.title: Claude (Anthropic) · 官方
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official account launched Claude for Teachers, built for K-12: teachers can have Claude start from their state standards and high-quality curricula (via Learning Commons), draft lesson plans and student-facing materials, then revise and take them to class. On privacy it's built for K-12—Anthropic never trains models on your conversations, and student data is protected by a FERPA-compliant data processing agreement. A concrete example of AI entering the education vertical, and of compliance as a prerequ…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方账号推出了 Claude for Teachers，专为 K-12 场景设计：老师可以让 Claude 从所在州的课程标准和高质量教材出发（通过 Learning Commons 连接），起草教案和面向学生的材料，再自行修改带进课堂。隐私上强调为 K-12 定制——不用对话训练模型，学生信息受符合 FERPA 的数据处理协议保护。对关注 AI 进入教育垂直、以及「合规是企业/机构级采用前提」这一趋势的人，是一个具体落地样本。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari offered a sharp observation about next-gen engineer habits: the pre-AI engineering leader can't comprehend that their most cracked engineer is also extremely online. His explanation—while agents work in the background, scrolling X becomes the dopamine spike engineers need while waiting. He predicts time-on-X in tech, especially among engineers, will keep going up. A neat lens on how agentic coding is reshaping developers' daily rhythm.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 提了一个关于新一代工程师工作习惯的敏锐观察：AI 之前的工程主管无法理解，为什么自己最顶尖的工程师同时也「极度在线」（extremely online）。他的解释是——当 agent 在后台跑活时，刷 X 成了工程师等待过程中的多巴胺补给。他预测科技圈尤其是工程师群体的「X 使用时长」会继续上升。这条对理解 agentic 编码如何改变开发者日常节奏很有意思。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer
items.summaryEn: Swyx organized a "Personal AI Engineers" demo night in SF for developers building personal agents. He noted the staying power of PAI (Personal AI) is remarkable—featured speakers from a past edition of this meetup got acquired by Amazon's hardware division, and two years later he's still a daily active user. A community and trend signal worth noting for builders in the personal-agent space.
items.insightZh: Swyx 在旧金山组织了一场「个人 AI 工程师（Personal AI Engineers）」的 demo 之夜，面向正在构建个人 agent 的开发者。他特别提到 PAI（Personal AI）这个方向的「持久力」惊人——上一次同类聚会的特邀讲者后来被亚马逊硬件部门收购，而两年后他本人仍是重度日活用户。对关注个人 agent 这条赛道的 builder，这是一个值得留意的社群与趋势信号。
